articles.title: Delays on Tram Replacement Bus Services Due to M62 Car Fire
articles.excerpt: Tram replacement bus services between Oldham Mumps and Rochdale Town Centre are facing delays following a car fire on the M62.
articles.content_html:
Tram replacement bus services operating between Oldham Mumps and Rochdale Town Centre are currently experiencing delays due to a car fire on the M62.

The incident has caused disruption on the network, impacting travel plans for those relying on these services.

Passengers are advised to allow extra time for their journeys and to check for further updates on travel conditions.

For more information, visit the TfGM Travel Alerts page at TfGM.

articles.title: Rochdale AFC Signs Kane Taylor on Loan from Birmingham City
articles.excerpt: Rochdale have secured the loan signing of Kane Taylor from Aston Villa, with the 21-year-old midfielder joining the club until January 2027.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Football Club has announced the signing of midfielder Kane Taylor from Aston Villa on loan until January 2027. The 21-year-old player joins Rochdale after a loan spell at Oldham Athletic last season, where he made 16 appearances and scored two goals, helping the team finish 10th in League Two.

Despite not yet making his senior debut for Aston Villa, Taylor has shown promise, scoring for the Villa Under-21s in an EFL Trophy match against Wigan earlier this week. His experience in League Two is expected to bolster Rochdale's midfield options as they aim for a successful season.

Rochdale manager Ian Watson expressed his delight at securing Taylor's services, stating, "He brings a lot of athleticism and quality to the team, alongside experience in League Two." Watson's comments highlight the club's focus on enhancing their squad ahead of the upcoming fixtures.

The addition of Taylor is likely to provide a boost to Rochdale's performance as they prepare for their next match. Fans will be eager to see how the young midfielder integrates into the team and contributes to their campaign.

articles.title: Rochdale AFC Launches New Series 'Behind The Sign'
articles.excerpt: Rochdale AFC has introduced a new series titled 'Behind The Sign', offering fans an inside look at the club's preparations for the upcoming season.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale AFC has launched a new series called 'Behind The Sign', providing fans with exclusive insight into the club's preparations for the upcoming season. The pilot episode was published on August 21, 2026, and is available on the club's official website.

The series will feature training sessions, player interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, allowing supporters to engage more deeply with the team.

Fans are encouraged to watch the episodes as they are released to keep up with the club's activities and developments throughout the season.

For more information and to view the pilot episode, visit the Rochdale AFC website at https://rochdaleafc.co.uk/behind-the-sign-crawley-prep/.
